title: Izwi Elithule Ekamelweni
intro: Umthandazo owaphindwa ethule ekamelweni elingcwele kudala, uvuka emphefumulweni osekhulile olangazelela lokho izwe elalikubize ngokuthi akunakwenzeka. Lesi sibalo, esikhulile ngeminyaka futhi sinomthwalo wokukhathazeka ngekusasa, saphendukela eNkosini yaso ngokunxusa komuntu siqu. Okwalandela kwaba impendulo yaphezulu eyamelana nakho konke okulindelwe ngokwemvelo—ubufakazi bomusa waLowo ophendula ubizo oluphelelwe yithemba.
clues: Ngabiza iNkosi yami ngasese, ngaya ekamelweni lapho ngazinikela khona ekukhulekeleni kwayo.
Ngavuma eNkosini yami ukuthi ngangisaba labo ababezoza emva kwami, ngikhathazekile ngesiqondiso sabantu bakithi uma sengihambile.
Ukuguga kwase kungificile—amathambo ami ayesebuthakathaka futhi izinwele ezimhlophe zase zisakazeke ekhanda lami.
Umlingani wami wayeyinyumba impilo yakhe yonke, kodwa ngisacela iNkosi yami ukuba ingiphe indlalifa evela ebukhoneni bayo.
Ngacela isibonakaliso, iNkosi yami yangiphendula ngokungivimba ukuthi ngingakhulumi nanoma ubani ubusuku obuthathu, kuyilapho ngihlala ngiphilile ngokomzimba.
Ngathenjiswa indodana ebizo layo linguYahya, igama iNkosi yami eyathi alikaze linikwe muntu ngaphambili.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
